summary: Curtiss-Wright filed an 8-K disclosing adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to repurchase $100 million of its common stock under an existing $390 million authorization. The plan, effective August 18, 2026, will buy shares up to Rule 10b-18 volume limits and is expected to complete by end of August 2026, leaving $290 million authorized. No specific price or premium; plan is a capital return mechanism. Watch for completion disclosures in periodic reports and potential future plans.
